metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a mended latch, an early quarter, a boat confirmed, a thin house, and a going put off by one day.

yesterday: The latch shuts. The twenty shillings are paid, and the receipt is in her law-hand.
Gannet is Wednesday's flood, six oars. He told three stories.
Errors is played, and it is the last at the Theatre this year. Four shillings and tenpence, and a yard of about sixty.
The Rose's bill was New World's Tragedy. You read it and stayed for Errors.
She goes tomorrow. The tilt-boat stands. In the morning, both heels.
